---
title: "Am I Ready to Code?"
---

Use this checklist after completing [Setup](Setup.qmd). Every item must be green before writing any feature code.

---

## ✅ Team registration

- [ ] Every teammate accepted the GitHub Classroom invitation
- [ ] One student created the team with the **exact teacher-defined name**
- [ ] Other students joined that same team
- [ ] A repository named after your team exists at `github.com/Estia-1a/pgi-2026-<team>`

---

## ✅ Environment

- [ ] Repository cloned locally (no accents or spaces in the path)
- [ ] VS Code opened on the cloned folder
- [ ] Recommended extensions installed (C/C++, CMake, GitHub Pull Requests)
- [ ] `gcc` available — verify: `gcc --version` prints a version number
- [ ] CMake available — verify: `cmake --version` prints a version number

---

## ✅ Libraries

- [ ] `estia-image` library installed (run `cmake --install build` from the library directory)
- [ ] `getopt` library installed
- [ ] Running `cmake -B build` in the project root completes without errors

---

## ✅ First build

- [ ] `cmake --build build` succeeds
- [ ] `cmake --install build` succeeds
- [ ] `./freud.exe --debug -f images/input/image.jpeg -c helloworld` prints output and creates an image

---

## ✅ GitHub workflows

- [ ] Issues loaded into your repository (the `create-issues` workflow completed)
- [ ] Milestones visible in your repository under `Issues → Milestones`
- [ ] At least one issue open and assigned

---

## ✅ Git cycle works

- [ ] You can make a change, `git commit`, and `git push` without errors
- [ ] Your teammates can `git pull` and see your changes
- [ ] GitHub Actions triggered after your push (visible under the `Actions` tab)

---

::: {.callout-tip}
## All boxes checked?

You are ready. Go to [First Steps](First-Steps.qmd) and start Milestone 1 as a team.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Something not working?

Check [Debugging & Troubleshooting](../Resources/Troubleshooting.qmd) — most setup issues are covered there.  
If you're stuck on a specific step, re-read the corresponding phase in [Setup](Setup.qmd).
:::
